items.title: Magnarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: Plus he also forced me to play first trumpet which was something that was foreign to me.

ctx.x: Yeah. What was Lionel like personally? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -4-

Well I never really hung out with him. He was 78 years old when I got the gig. But he was cool man. This was before he had his first stroke. He was still very strong. I mean he, I don’t know how to explain it but like when you stood next to him and you wanted to play the solo, but he was still playing the solo when you were playing the solo. He was still getting the house while you were playing the solo, okay? And that was the rule. Yeah he didn’t make it easy, man. Like you had to play over him. You had to fight…
Were you there at the same time as Byron Stripling?
